tools.name: develop.matchTotalExposures
tools.description:
Match Total Exposures — set each selected photo's Exposure so its rendered
brightness matches the active photo.

tools.name: develop.setAutoSync
tools.description:
Auto Sync — while on, mirror every develop edit to the active photo onto
the rest of the selection as you make it.

on.description: True to enable Auto Sync, false to disable.

tools.name: develop.sync
tools.description:
Sync Settings — push the active photo's develop recipe to the rest of the
current selection.

scope.description: Panels to push (e.g. basic, tone, color); omit to push the whole recipe.

tools.name: keywords.export
tools.description: Export Keywords — write the whole vocabulary as a tab-indented keyword file.

tools.name: keywords.import
tools.description:
Import Keywords — merge a tab-indented keyword file into the catalog
vocabulary. Existing names are reused, so a re-import is a no-op.

path.description: Absolute path to a tab-indented keyword list (.txt).

tools.name: library.import
tools.description: Import a photo file into the catalog by absolute path.

tools.name: library.selectNext
tools.description: Make the next photo in the grid active (for sequential culling).

tools.name: library.selectPrevious
tools.description: Make the previous photo in the grid active.

tools.name: library.setFilter
tools.description: Set the Library rating filter (show only photos rated at least minRating).

tools.name: library.summary
tools.description: Summarize the current Library state (counts + active photo).

tools.name: photo.flag
tools.description: Set the pick/reject flag of the active photo.

tools.name: photo.label
tools.description: Set the color label of the active photo.

color.description: Color label (red, yellow, green, blue, purple), or empty to clear.

tools.name: photo.makeMasterPhoto
tools.description:
Make Master Photo — promote the active virtual copy to master, demoting the
current master to a copy.

tools.name: photo.rate
tools.description: Set the star rating of the active photo.
